Let me try other actions: RIGHT, LEFT, DOWN, SPACE, and check the diffs. The timer bar decreases with each action, so I need to be careful: each action consumes one step of the timer. import copy
def field(frame):
    return [line[18:64] for line in frame.ascii.splitlines()[9:63]]
base = field(current_frame)
for act in ['RIGHT','DOWN','LEFT','SPACE']:
    r = action([act])
    res = last_action_result
    f = field(current_frame)
    diff = [(i,j) for i in range(len(f)) for j in range(len(f[i])) if f[i][j]!=base[i][j]]
    print(act, {k: res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','done','level_completed')}, 'diffcells:', len(diff), diff[:20])
    if res.get('no_impact') or res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed'): break
